paras: Application: 2020+ Toyota GR Supra (MK5) – B58 3.0L turbo only Part Type: Dual (PCV + CCV) Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0751-FL

Radium recommends the Dual Catch Can Kit for the ultimate in engine protection on the MK5 Supra – it combines the 20-0749-FL PCV kit and the 20-0750-FL CCV kit. The PCV can runs inline between the ventilation valve and the intake pipe, trapping metered crankcase vapour, unspent fuel and oil sludge; the CCV can runs inline between the crankcase vent port and the intake pipe, catching the high crankcase flow under WOT that would otherwise reach the intercooler.
